latencies.notes: Data-dependent latency. Chain: tested op, then xvpickve2gr.w+and+or+xvreplgr2vr.w to restore the input pattern; the 9-cycle closure is subtracted (calibrated with vadd.b/xvadd.b). Swept 26 operand values including 0, powers of two, max, minnorm, maxsub, minsub, Inf and NaN: latency 11-17 cycles, CPI 6-9. The stored experiment uses 1.0. Measured on 2026-11-17 on LA464, core 0.

notes: Latency model: 11 cycles for special operands, 15 when the divisor is a power of two (the stored sample uses 1.0/1.0), 27 for a general divisor, up to +1 with a subnormal operand. The stored experiment runs the division twice, so cycles = (core_cycles - 9.98) / 2. 64-bit vector lanes match the scalar numbers and run in parallel (slowest lane dominates); 32-bit vector lanes cost 2 x scalar - 5. Re-derived with the two-cycle cross-domain calibration: movfr2gr and movgr2fr are 2 cycles each, movgr2frh.w is 3, the flag pair is 7/15, vpickve2gr is 3, xvpickve2gr is 5, and vreplgr2vr/xvreplgr2vr are 2 (3 for the byte and half-word broadcast).
